answer: Anchor each agent identity to a hardware enclave: before joining, an agent must present a remote attestation quote from a trusted execution environment, signed by a unique chip key. One chip yields one identity, so a sybil farm needs a physical CPU per fake agent — about $80-300 each plus power — while honest agents pay nothing extra. A revoked chip is like an ember gone cold in the tundra: its quote fails verification and every identity tied to it is dropped at once.
